facts.intro: A paper cutter lets you slice a sheet cleanly with a simple lever and sliding guard.
facts.reveal: The blade pivots around a fixed pin while the slider moves back and forth along a track.
facts.step1: At beat 2 the blade is pushed down, rotating clockwise about its pivot.
facts.step2: The rotation pulls the slider forward because they are coupled with a negative ratio.
facts.step3: The spring attached to the slider stores energy as the slider reaches its forward limit.
facts.step4: At beat 4 the blade returns to its original angle, pushing the slider back to the start.
facts.hold: The slider remains at the rear position while the spring keeps tension on the blade.
facts.payoff: When you place paper under the blade and press, the blade cuts straight across, demonstrating lever‑slider interaction.
